construction_notes.text: City of San Jose permit PRE22-003 (Prelim - Focused (Policy Review, No Plans), folder year 2022), status Complete: "SB330 preliminary application for a multifamily residential building consisting of 46 units"

State Table A2 (2021) row for file H20-007: 46 rental units (14 low-income deed-restricted, 32 above-moderate), entitled 2021-09-29, 6 units demolished, density bonus. The row lists APNs 467-17-044, -045 and -046, no longer in county data; county parcel 467-17-112 (488 E St John St) is the current parcel at this address.

City file HA20-007-01 (approved 2022-12-07) amends the approved project to remove the underground parking and bring all parking to grade, add a partial fifth floor, and change the unit mix and increase unit sizes; addendum ER22-035 to the 488 E. St. John Street Residential IS/MND covers the height increase and garage removal.

SF YIMBY (2021): 46 apartments with 14 affordable units for a 35% density bonus, four stories and 46.6 feet, rooftop garden, leasing office and community room; Draft MND public comment period August 2 to 23, 2021.
Earlier city preliminary reviews on the site: PRE17-026 (21 units, applicant David Lawver) and PRE19-050 (33 units, four stories, applicant Peter Ko, KO Architects).
